summary: Creatd, Inc. filed an 8-K on September 29, 2026, disclosing a September 23 Share Exchange Agreement with C2 Capital Group, Inc. d/b/a C2 Live, a Nevada corporation. Creatd issued 300,000 common shares and 25,064 Series B Convertible Preferred shares, convertible into 668,361 common shares, receiving 968,361 newly issued C2 shares representing a 10% stake. The exchange was on a one-for-one common-equivalent basis at $3.75 per share, the September 22 OTCQB close. No cash consideration was paid; the preferred is non-voting, has a $100 stated value, a $3.75 fixed conversion price, a 4.99% beneficial ownership cap, and a six-month conversion lockup. Watch for dilution and liquidity overhang, conversion timing, and C2 valuation marks.
